title: THE BOTTLE | It Was So Small
description:
The first time, it was small enough to sit on the rim of his glass. Every drink, it grew a size.

THE BOTTLE | It Was So Small is an animated short film about the habit that grows every time you feed it, and the man who starved it back down to the size it was when they met.

What was your "just one"? Tell me in the comments.

#shortfilm #animation #selfimprovement #addiction #sobriety
